primaryWitnesses.text: Moreover he burned incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burned his children in the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: but he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and also made molten images for the Baals.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

primaryWitnesses.text: He also made his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom. He practiced sorcery, divination, and witchcraft, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards. He did much evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of the LORD’s house.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: He set the engraved image of the idol, which he had made, in God’s house, of which God said to David and to Solomon his son, “In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever.
